v0_14_3_changes: Follower animation tier detection now uses verified native PlayerController static fields isMoving/isRunning/ridingBroom.
Removed moveMod classification from follower animation tier detection because it caused walking/running animation speeds to appear swapped.
Kept config multipliers idle=0.75, walk=1, run=1.5, broom=2.
Updated AIO patcher/version metadata and manifest to v0.14.3_FollowerAnimationTierFix.
Added consolidated README, artifacts/baselines doc, and this handoff JSON.

architecture.launcher: WPF launcher stages online payload and restores user mods after game close. Online Play requires validated launcher account.
architecture.account_flow: Account Website account -> launcher login/session -> game ticket/session config -> custom title Log In -> online save slot selector.
architecture.follower: Follower behavior is now owned by AIO merged runtime in Client/MMOnsterpatchOfficialServerPatcher/AIOFollowersMergedRuntime.cs. No standalone follower runtime DLL is staged in the active payload.
architecture.world_spawns: Server owns visible overworld spawn identity/lifecycle. Client renders and requests local generation for species/legal data. v0.14.2 added map population target and water-zone support.
architecture.database: Current working DB backend is SQLite: AccountWebsite uses Data/Accounts/auth.db; Python server uses OfficialServer/data/bank.db and social.db. MariaDB files are scaffold/future, not live yet.
